mechanism_analysis.depth.reason: Each axis is tied to the per-frequency diagonal-plus-rank structure. Partition gives rank-r copies, with solve work Θ(KrMN) against transform work Θ((K/r)MN log N) and memory 2(K/r)MN. Majoriser is an exact rank-r solve or a gradient step with no r factor. Inner solver is r sequential Sherman–Morrison stages or tolerance-dependent CG. Coupling: σ is the diagonal shift, with σ∝r derived from data replication. Representation: under R1, C multiplies the right-hand sides; under R2, it multiplies the rank. Basis changes block-diagonal into block-circulant with identical iterates. Falsifiable predictions were stated and tested: a U-shaped per-iteration cost with an interior minimum (0.585/0.351/0.675 s), collapse of convergence curves under σ∝r, and quadratic ISM versus linear Cns/FISTA growth in K. The paper also states where each choice should lose: large B for ISM, large C for rank-C groups. The basis-axis and CG cost discussions are thinner than the others.
